<canvas id="game" aria-label="Sky Chase 8 flight arena"></canvas>
<header><div class="brand"><div class="eyebrow">ALL.AI / ARCADE 005</div><h1>SKY CHASE <b>8.1</b> ✈</h1><div class="small">MINNESOTA / FIGHTER COLLECTION</div></div><div id="scorebox" class="glass"><div class="metric"><strong id="score">0000</strong><span>SCORE</span></div><div class="metric"><strong id="wave">01</strong><span>WAVE</span></div><div class="metric"><strong id="kills">00</strong><span>TAKEDOWNS</span></div></div><div id="netbox" class="glass"><div id="net">WAKE · connecting</div><div class="small" id="netInfo">Auto-join · cooperative squad</div><div id="players"></div></div></header>
<div id="objective"><strong>OPERATION / MINNESOTA</strong><p>Hunt the amber interceptors.<br>Protect your WAKE wingmates.</p><span class="small">32 × 32 km · real terrain · 1× relief</span></div>
<div id="placeLabels"></div><div id="geoInfo"><span id="location">Minnesota terrain ready</span><br><span>Terrain: Mapzen/AWS · Imagery: Esri & contributors · Lake: Metropolitan Council</span></div><div id="aircraftBar" class="glass"><select id="aircraft" aria-label="Aircraft"><option value="f22">F-22 Raptor</option><option value="f35">F-35A Lightning II</option><option value="su57">Su-57</option></select><button id="inspectJet">🔎 Inspect</button><span id="aircraftSpec">18.9 m long · 13.6 m span</span></div><div id="reticle"></div><div id="lock"></div><div id="pauseMark">AUTOPILOT HOLD</div><div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<div id="telemetry"><span class="small">AIRSPEED</span><br><strong id="speed">0</strong> <span class="small">KM/H</span><div class="bar"><i id="boostbar"></i></div><span class="small" id="hullText">SHIELD 100</span><div class="bar"><i id="hullbar"></i></div><span class="small" id="altitude">ALT 240 M</span></div><canvas id="radar" width="220" height="220" aria-label="Radar: cyan allies and amber enemies"></canvas>
<div id="hint">W / S pitch · A / D turn · Q / E roll · Space fire · Shift boost · F missile · C camera · P auto</div>
<footer class="glass"><button id="auto">🧠 Auto</button><select id="camera" aria-label="Camera"><option>Chase</option><option>Cockpit</option><option>Top</option><option>Side</option><option>Flyby</option><option>Inspect</option></select><button id="sound">🔊 Sound</button><button id="media">🎵 Music</button><button id="record" class="primary">⏺ 60s MP4</button><button id="stop" disabled>⏹</button><button id="last" disabled>💾 Clip</button><button id="share">↗ Share</button><button id="help">?</button><span id="recStatus"></span></footer>
<div id="touch"><div id="stick" aria-label="Flight joystick"><div id="knob"></div></div><div id="touchActions"><button id="touchBoost">BOOST</button><button id="touchMissile">LOCK</button><button id="touchAuto">AUTO</button><button id="touchFire" class="primary">FIRE</button></div></div>
<div id="start"><div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">WAKE SQUADRON / READY FOR TAKEOFF</div><h2>OWN THE<br><span style="color:var(--ice)">HORIZON.</span></h2><p>Fly the real shores of Lake Minnetonka in three detailed fifth-generation fighters.</p><button id="launch" class="primary" disabled>Loading flight systems…</button><button id="demo" disabled>🧠 Auto flight</button><p class="small">Eight pilots · endless waves · your soundtrack</p><div id="error" role="alert"></div></div></div>
<dialog id="mediaDialog"><button class="close" data-close>✕</button><h2>🎵 Flight soundtrack</h2><p>Load your own MP3. Music and flight effects are mixed into the recording.</p><input id="musicFile" type="file" accept="audio/*"><audio id="music" controls loop></audio><label>Music volume <input id="musicVolume" type="range" min="0" max="1" step=".05" value=".65"></label><label>Clip format<select id="format"><option value="landscape">Landscape · 1280 × 720</option><option value="portrait">Portrait · 720 × 1280</option></select></label><p class="small">60 seconds · 30 fps capture · 50 fps render cap. MP4 is used when your browser exposes an MP4 encoder; otherwise the download is honestly labeled WebM. For X, use the posting script’s --convert option to ensure H.264 + AAC.</p></dialog>
<dialog id="shareDialog"><button class="close" data-close>✕</button><h2>↗ Share the sortie</h2><p>Post your downloaded clip first, then add the multiplayer + source reply.</p><label>1 · Video post<textarea id="postText" rows="3">✈️ Sky Chase 8.1 — F-22, F-35A and Su-57 over real Lake Minnetonka terrain. Built with Astra + Three.js. Join WAKE and record your best 60 seconds. Multiplayer + full code in the reply. #ThreeJS #GameDev</textarea></label><div class="row"><button id="postX">Open X composer</button><button id="shareClip">Share clip</button></div><label>2 · Reply<textarea id="replyText" rows="4"></textarea></label><label>Published video post URL<input id="postURL" type="url" placeholder="https://x.com/yourname/status/123…"></label><div class="row"><button id="replyX">Open linked reply</button><button id="copyLinks">Copy reply</button></div><label>Invite a wingmate<input id="invite" readonly></label><button id="copyInvite">Copy WAKE URL</button><p class="small">Composers need you to attach the clip and press Post. For automatic video upload + reply, use Sky-Chase-8-post-x.py with your X user access token on your computer. Never put tokens in this HTML.</p><a id="sourceLink" href="Sky-Chase-8-source.txt" download>Download full HTML + JS source</a> · <a href="Sky-Chase-8-post-x.py" download>X automation script</a></dialog>
<dialog id="helpDialog"><button class="close" data-close>✕</button><h2>✈ Flight school</h2><p><b>W/S</b> climb/dive · <b>A/D</b> turn · <b>Q/E</b> roll · <b>Space</b> cannon · <b>Shift</b> afterburner · <b>F</b> homing missile · <b>C</b> camera · <b>P</b> auto flight.</p><p>Drag on the sky to steer; drag with the right mouse button to orbit your chase camera. Touch pilots use the left stick and action buttons. Steering takes over from auto flight.</p><p>Hold a target near your nose to lock. Missiles need a lock and recharge in 3 seconds. Fly through cyan rings to repair. If your shield breaks, you return after 3 seconds.</p><p>WAKE automatically joins up to eight pilots through PeerJS. Cyan jets are allies; amber jets are enemies. The active squad leader runs shared enemies. Internet/signaling and a working peer connection are required for cross-device play; solo AI continues if networking fails.</p><label>Call sign<input id="callsign" maxlength="18" value="MAVERICK"></label><button id="saveName">Save call sign</button></dialog>

setTimeout(()=>{if(!window.SKY_READY)document.getElementById('error').textContent='Still loading Three.js. Check your connection, allow cdn.jsdelivr.net, then reload.'},15000);
</script>

function batchAirframe(root){
